vulnerable_statements.reason: xe_irq_install() registers a devm-managed action that uninstalls the IRQ and frees its handler when the device is released. The err_irq_shutdown path also tears down the IRQ by hand. If probe fails after xe_irq_install() succeeds, the IRQ is released twice: once here and again when devm unwinds. This double release can trigger a free_irq() on an already-freed handler or a use-after-free of IRQ state.
Every failure after IRQ installation (flat CCS, VRAM probe, tile init, display noaccel, GT init, display init) jumps to the manual IRQ shutdown, which duplicates the devm cleanup.

suggested_fix: Let devm be the only owner of IRQ teardown. Remove the manual xe_irq_shutdown() call from the error path and send those failures to the display cleanup label instead. Alternatively, make xe_irq_shutdown() idempotent by checking and clearing an 'irq enabled' flag so the second release does nothing. Make sure each resource has exactly one release path, either manual or devm.
